children: Morgan Stanley has broadly lowered its target prices for China stock indices as deteriorating macro data, tighter liquidity and fund-flow prospects, and concerns over stronger government oversight of capital flows and wealth management weigh on sentiment, Bloomberg reported.
The move reflects the bank's view that the outlook for liquidity and capital inflows has tightened, while investors are also worried about regulatory pressure on fund flows and wealth management.

title: Morgan Stanley Cuts China Stock Index Targets On Weaker Data, Tighter Liquidity
